questions.q_en:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

432 * 9 * 3 * 2 * 5 * 4 = 33
questions.solution_en:
Option (a): After replacement,

LHS = 432 ÷ 9 ÷ 3 X 2 + 5 - 4

= 48 ÷ 3 X 2 + 5 - 4

= 16 X 2 + 5 - 4

= 32 + 5 - 4

= 37 - 4

= 33 = RHS [Satisfied]

Option (b): After replacement,

LHS = 432 ÷ 9 X 3 ÷ 2 + 5 - 4

= 48 X 3 ÷ 2 + 5 - 4

= 144 ÷ 2 + 5 - 4

= 72 + 5 - 4

= 77 - 4

= 73 ≠ RHS [Not satisfied]

Option (c): After replacement,

LHS = 432 ÷ 9 ÷ 3 + 2 X 5 - 4

= 48 ÷ 3 + 2 X 5 - 4

= 16 + 2 X 5 - 4

= 16 + 10 - 4

= 26 - 4

= 22 ≠ RHS [Not satisfied]

Option (d): After replacement,

LHS = 432 ÷ 9 X 3 + 2 X 5 - 4

= 48 X 3 + 2 X 5 - 4

= 144 + 10 - 4

= 154 - 4

= 150 ≠ RHS [Not satisfied]

questions.q_en: In a class, seven students are given different ranks such that the one who got highest marks was ranked highest i.e. rank 1 and the one who got lowest was ranked lowest. Number of students ranked higher than Q is same as that ranked lower than S. K's marks are less than J's. S is ranked just higher than J. D's marks are lower than T but more than Q, who is ranked higher than S. N's marks are more than J. What is N's rank?
questions.solution_en:
K's marks are less than J's.

K < J

S is ranked just higher than J. so, S's marks are more than J's.

Also, N's marks are more than J's.

K < J < S , N

D's marks are lower than T but more than Q, who is ranked higher than S

Thus, we get,

K < J < S < Q < D < T

Number of students ranked higher than Q is same as that ranked lower than S.

Thus, N must be between Q and S.

Finally, we get -

K < J < S < N (4) < Q (3) < D (2) < T (1)

N's rank is 4th.

questions.q_en: What was the day of the week on 26th November 1994?
questions.solution_en:
We know that, in every 1600 years = 0 odd days.

The next 400 years = 0 odd days

Thus, 1st January 2001 will be Monday.

Years 1996 and 2000 were leap years. So, 2 odd days.

So, time period from 1994 to 2000 = 1 odd day+ 1 odd day+ 2 odd days+ 1 odd day+ 1 odd day+ 1 odd day+ 2 odd days)

= (1+1+2+1+1+1+2) = 9

9/7 = remainder = 2.

So, on 1 January 1994 = Monday - 2 days= Saturday.

So, time period from 2 January 1994 to 26 November 1994:

=30+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+31+26 days

Number of odd days = (2+0+3+2+3+2+3+3+2+3)+26 days

= 23 days +26 days =49 days.

So, 49/7, the remainder will be 0.

Thus, 26th November 1994 was Saturday.
